$description: Every width breakpoint found in MNG production code, classified as official, component or drift (EXPORT-STANDARD.md section 6); third-party and WordPress admin-bar values are left out. Built by scripts/breakpoint-inventory/build-inventory.py; never edit by hand. Drift is logged in design-vs-production.md (entries 28, 32, 33) with the official breakpoint to snap to.
method: Live CSS scan (scan.js) of every loaded stylesheet, @media width conditions only, on the homepage, an article and the obituaries page of each review site, at a 1728px-wide window (media rules are read from the CSS, so the window width does not matter). Cross-origin sheets were fetched; the HTL ad bidder sheet was blocked on most sites. em/rem converted at 16px. JavaScript breakpoints (matchMedia, window.innerWidth) are not included.

excluded.specialInvestigativeHeader: Left out for now (max-width 730 / 1150, plus shared 500 / 600 / 750 / 900 / 1024). Not found on a live page of the 6 sites; find it in production when more article pages are added to WordPress Elements (Karl, 2026-10-14).
excluded.note: Third-party breakpoints (Mg2 Connext paywall, Osano, Kargo, HTL ad bidder) and the WordPress admin bar (logged-in editors only) are not ours, so they are left out (Karl, 2026-10-14).
